reconcile.note: Gill answers that John's silence about the kiss is simply an omission of a detail the other evangelists already recorded, not a denial that it happened.

sides.snippet: Whoever I kiss, he is the one. Seize him.
sides.verseText: Now he who betrayed him gave them a sign, saying, \"Whoever I kiss, he is the one. Seize him.\"

sides.snippet: Jesus said to them, \"I AM.\" Judas also, who betrayed him, was standing with them.
sides.verseText: They answered him, \"Jesus of Nazareth.\" Jesus said to them, \"I AM.\" Judas also, who betrayed him, was standing with them.
